title: SLA Microbundle and Retention Toggle Pilot for Enterprise Contract Flow
creator: Sofia Nguyen
description: Run a focused pilot that packages a short, low-friction 'microbundle' for enterprise prospects combining: (1) configurable telemetry retention toggles (30d | 90d | 365d), (2) a lightweight compliance pack (SOC2 checklist, data residency notes, KMS integration guide) gated behind a contract questionnaire, and (3) a guaranteed premium SLA (4xx/5xx and latency SLOs) as an optional paid add-on. Goal: validate pricing sensitivity and contract friction reduction through a templated questionnaire + entitlement mapping to Console feature flags. Deliverables: pilot pricing matrix, entitlement mapping, contract questionnaire template, release playbook for sales/legal, and telemetry on conversions and support lift.
hypothesis: Packaging retention toggles + compliance docs + a clearly described premium SLA into a single microbundle will increase enterprise conversion rate by at least 12% while keeping per-customer support requests for security reviews below 1.5/month during the pilot. The questionnaire will reduce bespoke legal cycles by 30%.
success_metrics: ARR from microbundle >= $250k within first 6 months if rolled out
acceptance_criteria: Sales can enable microbundle entitlement via Console for a customer account
Questionnaire responses map to a deterministic entitlement state in the admin UI
Billing can generate a line-item for the microbundle with tiered pricing
Legal confirms questionnaire output is sufficient to skip full security review for low-risk customers
Telemetry retention toggle behaves as advertised in Dedicated and Private deployments (config + audit log)

notes: Trade-offs discussed: bundling increases perceived value but may cannibalize upsells where customers otherwise buy observability retention separately.
Fallback policy: If an entitlement mapping returns inconsistent answers across questionnaire revisions, escalate to Solutions Eng for manual review; create an automated ticket with context.
We will collect qualitative feedback from Sales reps after each contract close to surface questionnaire puzzling items to iterate UX.

Pricing mechanics: propose three microbundle tiers tied to retention length (Basic-30d, Standard-90d, Enterprise-365d) + one-time setup for SLA onboarding. Final price TBD; run price A/B with two cohorts.
risks: Risk: Customers interpret the 'microbundle' as insufficient and request full audits—mitigation: clearly label microbundle as 'starter compliance pack' and surface upgrade path.
Risk: Entitlement automation misclassifies a customer and enables longer retention than contract allows—mitigation: strong server-side validation + audit logs + legal sign-off checkbox.
Risk: Sales churn if pricing is misaligned—mitigation: cap pilot discounts and require Sales to file post-mortem for each churned account.
